floodnet.outcome_definition: Study R9 cell is positive if it contains ≥1 FloodNet sensor with ≥1 QC street-flooding event in aq7i-eu5q; scores are spatial-CV OOF probabilities from the composite open-evidence model (FloodNet excluded).

baselines.note: Trivial baselines for the Lower Manhattan Option B fold table (n_test pooled=262). Positive prevalence 0.6374.

rows.note: max aggregation Jaccard near 1.0 can be structural (parent collapse under max), not a preferred strategy
max aggregation Jaccard near 1.0 can be structural (parent collapse under max), not a preferred strategy

source_ablation.note: Source-ablation (M2): same spatial H3-block CV (k=2 parent blocks, 5 folds, GBM) refit to seven target definitions to test construct validity of the composite max(dep_area_frac, complaint_presence, ida_hwm_presence) target; includes complaint_no_building_density. ROC-AUC is the headline ranking-discrimination metric; accuracy/F1 are threshold-dependent. Single-class targets are not fitted.

slr_sensitivity.note: Sea-level sensitivity (M4): the composite target is re-assembled with the DEP 'Moderate Flood with 2050 Sea Level Rise' layer (Layer 2, same Flooding_Category 1-2 filtering) and compared against the current-sea-level primary (Layer 1) under the same spatial H3-block CV (k=2 parent blocks, 5 folds, GBM). Both DEP variants are H&H model outputs.

adaptive.note: Cell-count accounting only (deployment_full in-sample selection); not runtime/efficiency claim.

rows.note: Fixed = keep all coarse cells; adaptive = refine high-score parents to fine_res. Hotspot recall vs uniform fine is under adaptive_* keys when estimated.

negative_control.note: coastal overlay is a negative control, not a training label; metrics are on the live open-data stack (still Lower Manhattan / stated bbox, not citywide; not PFIb)

sandy_311_window_sensitivity.note: 311 complaints with created_date in the Sandy landfall window [2012-10-27, 2012-11-05] are excluded before rebuilding the composite max(dep, complaint, hwm) target. Coastal diagnostic still uses OOF model scores from the primary (unmodified) CV, never the target score.

oof_extended_metrics.hyperparameter_provenance: GBM hyperparameters (n_estimators=80, max_depth=4, learning_rate=0.08, seed=42) are pre-specified in src/pluvial_flood_risk/config.py and estimators.py with no nested CV retuning.
oof_extended_metrics.urban_flag_note: land_cover_urban removed from FEATURE_COLUMNS / estimator inputs (deterministic copy of impervious_frac; no independent information).

land_mask_sensitivity.note: True land-mask sensitivity on Option B LM using NHDPlus water polygons (NHDArea/NHDWaterbody) from hydro_streams.geojson. land_frac = 1 - (cell ∩ water)/cell_area; centroid_on_land excludes cell centres inside water polygons. Primary spatial CV recomputed per mask.

polygon_area_threshold_sensitivity.note: Composite rebuilt with DEP area-fraction thresholds 0 / 1% / 5% / 10% (post-urban-drop features).

hwm_quality_oof_validation.note: Quality-filtered OOF score validation on expanded-pilot HWM cells (Excellent/Good in ida_hwm_quality), plus USGS height_above_gnd diagnostic.

height_above_gnd_diagnostic.note: Diagnostic only: USGS HWM height_above_gnd vs expanded-pilot OOF probability; not used as a training target.

hwm_validation.note: Quality-filtered OOF score validation on expanded-pilot HWM cells (Excellent/Good in ida_hwm_quality), plus USGS height_above_gnd diagnostic.

height_above_gnd_diagnostic.note: Diagnostic only: USGS HWM height_above_gnd vs expanded-pilot OOF probability; not used as a training target.

lower_manhattan.note: Operating threshold selected by maximising F1 on the training fold only, then applied to the held-out fold. Never tuned on test.

manhattan_expanded.note: Operating threshold selected by maximising F1 on the training fold only, then applied to the held-out fold. Never tuned on test.

adaptive_r11_hotspot_retention.note: True R11 feature re-extraction on refined parents' children using the post-urban-drop deployment model; cells with NaN static features (DEM edge) are dropped before scoring. Hotspot recall vs uniformly scored scorable R11.
